text: Duff Anloods (Japanese: , Daibā Haindo) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Anlood family that are fought at level 27 during the third wave of the Challenge Battle Grazing Flock. This enemy drops no items.

Duran Ignas (Japanese: , Dyuran Igūna) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Igna family that are fought at level 102 during the first wave of the Challenge Battle Humanoid Alliance. This enemy drops no items.

Dyone Gogols (Japanese: , Daion Gogōru) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Gogol family fought at level 99 during the first wave of the Challenge Battle Reinventing the Gogol. This enemy drops no items.

Dread Contagion is a Challenge Battle in . It can be received from the Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This challenge must be completed in order to unlock Elma's level 4 "Overdrive" Battle Skill. This challenge takes place on Highway 8 in the Land of Morytha.
The Elaborate Carving is a Key Item in . It is dropped by the Hermit Tirkin during the DLC Quest Passion of the Artisan.
Draconic Lunge (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using Knives. This art recycles Mòrag's Halo Strike.
Draco is an NPC in . He is an Urayan and can be found at the gate of Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Ebullient Core Crystal is a special Core Crystal in . It allows to awake Crossette. It can be obtained after installing the Patch (Ver.1.5.1) and the New Rare Blade Pack 2 from the Expansion Pass, then getting the A Firecracker of a Gal Key Item.

The Dross Igna (Japanese: , Jankā Igūna) is a quest-exclusive enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. It is a member of the Igna family, and can be found at level 59 in the Isle of Urchon of the Leftherian Archipelago during the DLC quest Bright Spark, alongside the Larm and Scram Ignas. This enemy drops no items.
Dragon Fang (Japanese: , Doragonfangu) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when wielding an Uchigatana.
Dynasty Sweep (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when wielding an Uchigatana.
Driver Coaching is a quest in . It can be received from Rolipoli at the Yanchik Harbor in the Kingdom of Torna.

Duelists' Bridge (Japanese: , Kettōbashi) is a location in . It is located in the far western area of Gormott. The bridge itself is a rocky path that winds above a large pool of water, and leads to Nox Promontory. There is a Treasure Trove and several green barrels containing Red Pollen Orbs here.
Edgestrike (Japanese: , Sutoraikuejji, Lit. "Strike Edge") is one of Addam's Rear Guard Arts in .

Eks Tails are Enemy Part collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna. One place to obtain them are from the Slade Eks just to the west of the Aletta: Militia Garrison travel point in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna.

Droth Urchons (Japanese: , Dorosu Unin) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Urchon family and can be found at level 36 - 38 exclusively on the Turqos Plateau in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna.

Dread Caterpiles (Japanese: , Doreddo Kyapiru) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Caterpile family, and can be found at level 26-31 at Coolley Lake, Duelists' Bridge, Seigle Fell, and Valafum Hill in Gormott. They may also be summoned by Gray Buloofo at level 36 - 40 by using its art "Beast Howl". Two must be defeated to unlock Aegaeon's level 3 Hundred-Year Wave.
Dudan is an NPC in . He is a Nopon salvager who can be found in Lascham Cove on Gormott. Dudan gives the quest Salvage the Salvager, upon completion of which his Community is gained.

The Elect Gogol (Japanese: , Erekuto Gogōru) is a quest exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Gogol family, and can be found at level 39 on Planus Bridge in the Kingdom of Torna, along with five Calculating Gogols, during Manning the Gates. As with all quest exclusive enemies in , it drops no items, only gold.
Elba is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti warrior who can be found in Gormott at the Hoary Weald Camp. He gives no quests, but his Community is gained once spoken to after Lora is knighted.
Ekurt is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who is found at Elmos Square in the Kingdom of Tantal, one of very few non-Tantalese individuals.

Durall Buloofos are quest exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Buloofo family, and can be found at level 37 in Gormott during the quest Passing the Torch. As with all quest exclusive enemies in , they drop no items, only gold. A Durall Buloofo spawns alongside four Innocent Volffs on Duelists' Bridge only when the party must reach Nox Promontory; once the treasure has been collected they disappear. They do not need to be fought to complete the quest.

Drydry (Japanese: , Dodora) is a Nopon in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. He is a Ponspector of the red team met in Alcamoth's Main Entrance. He gives the quest Drydry Entia. Drydry has been Ponspecting for eight years, and is the only NPC in Future Connected to be found in Alcamoth, having followed a High Entia - presumably Tyrea or Teelan, as the only ones known to frequent Alcamoth - to get there. Drydry is obsessed with High Entia aesthetics and lifestyle.

Drydry Entia (Japanese: , Dodorantā) is a quest in . It can be received from Drydry at the Main Entrance of Alcamoth. Completing it will cause Drydry to join the active group of Ponspectors. It is the only quest available in Alcamoth in .

Dubious Sculptures (Japanese: , Kaigi no Obuje) are collectables in . They can be found on the Bionis' Shoulder. According to the description, they are hollowed-out objects of unknown origin, timorously dubbed by Shulk. They are spawned at the highest rate (25%) by three collection points in Zekr Marga Quarry.

The Dozy Eluca (Japanese: , Madoromi no Erūka) is a Quest Exclusive Enemy in . It is a member of the Eluca family, and can be found near the Purifying Falls on the Bionis' Shoulder during Shoulder Survey Snaps in the daytime. It will despawn upon completion of the quest but need not be defeated. The party takes a photo of it for Melekanze. As with all quest-exclusive enemies in , the Dozy Eluca drops no chests.
Elastic Ivies are five Key Items in . They are found in the woods along Thulles Way, and are required for Brace for Friendship given by Angela.

Dreaming Big (Japanese: , Netemosametemo) is a Quiet Moment in . It is located west of Gran Dell Approach on the Bionis' Shoulder, between Nene and Kino, during the afternoon in clear weather and once the Deinos Sauros is defeated.
Electric Circus (Japanese: , Erekutorikkusākasu) is Pandoria's Level II Blade Special in .
Earth Priestess (Japanese: ) is Nim's Level IV Blade Special in .
Earth Breath (Japanese: , Āsu Buresu) is Cressidus's Level III Blade Special in . Earth Breath is also Cressidus's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the .
Droppicium is a Key Item in . It can be crafted by Hugo at Campsites.
Elderwood Hair Ties are light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. For unknown reasons they were cut from the game. They can only be worn by Kino.
Elderwood Vests are light torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. For unknown reasons they were cut from the game. They can only be worn by Kino.
Elderwood Amulets are light arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. For unknown reasons they were cut from the game. They can only be worn by Kino.
Elderwood Knapsacks are light legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. For unknown reasons they were cut from the game. They can only be worn by Kino.
Elderwood Anklets are light feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. For unknown reasons they were cut from the game. They can only be worn by Kino.
Dragguia Ropl are normal enemies in . They are members of the Ropl family, and can be found at level 33-35 in the Dannagh Desert.
Edge Thrust (Japanese: , Surasuto ejji, Thrust Edge) is a Battle Art in . It is one the arts of the Swordfighter class. It can also inflict heavy damage when attacking from the back.
The Eagus Wilderness (Japanese: , Īgusu Arano) is an Area in the Fornis Region in . The remains of the Mechonis' Fallen Arm make up this desert. Colony 4 is located here.
Elaice Highway (Japanese: , Eresu Daidō) is an Area in the Fornis Region in . The remnants of the Mechonis' Fallen Arm make up parts of this location. Colony Iota is located here.
Earth Crusher (Japanese: , Āsukurasshā) is a Battle Art in . It is one of Sena's Ouroboros arts.
Dragon Tail (Japanese: , Doragonteiru) is a Battle Art in . It is one of Noah's Ouroboros arts.

The Drifter Ropl is a Story Exclusive Enemy in . It is a member of the Ropl family, and is fought at level 6 west of the Alfeto Valley Mouth in Alfeto Valley during Chapter 1. After the Drifter Ropl is defeated, Mwamba leaves the party.
Eilis (Japanese: , Airisu) is an NPC in who can be found in Colony 9. __TOC__
Eastman () is a NPC in who can be found in Colony 9. He is part of Kite's squad alongside Trish and Fox. __TOC__
Dumas' Jaw (Japanese: , Dyūma no Ago) is a Location in , located on Rae-Bel Tableland.
Driving Arrow (Japanese: , Doraibuarō) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Stalker class.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Dragonfang Necklaces are Accessories in and . The common variant can be purchased from the Korresia's Shop. The legendary variant can be obtained from Intrusive Neville. In , the legendary variant can be obtained from Fograptor D'nari.
Dow Dolmen (Japanese: , Dau no Sekimon, Dow Stone Gate) is a Landmark in , located on Rae-Bel Tableland in the Fornis Region. It connects to Pelza's Pass on the Urayan Trail.
Ekdaso Verge (Japanese: , Ekudaso no Gake) is a Landmark in . It is located on the Syra Hovering Reefs in the Keves Castle Region.

Dunesea Marcellus (Japanese: , Daisakai no Māserasu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Marrin family, and can be found at level 87 in the Devil's Skillet in the Dannagh Desert. The Strike Shirker Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Dreadwyrm Nizoont (Japanese: , Sanretsuryū Niruzuvinto, Cruel Dragon Nilsvint) is one of the Superbosses in . It is a Unique Monster and a member of the Drague family, and can be found at level 105 behind the Forgotten Trick Gate at the end of the Cavern of Oblivion in Low Maktha Wildwood. Dreadwyrm Nizoont guards the pedestal where the Legendary Biter is located on. The Hot Soul Skill can be earned by the Soulhacker class when defeating it. Through re-challenging, Dreadwyrm Nizoont's level can increase to a maximum at level 170.
Dragues are a family of monsters in . They resemble the Dragons from and Draiguls from .
Drainage Sluice (Japanese: , Haisuikō) is a Landmark in . It is located in Keves Castle Drainage.
The East Gate Road (Japanese: , Higashi Gēto-dōri) is a Landmark in . It is located in Fort O'Virbus on the Syra Hovering Reefs.
Eldritch Obelisk (Japanese: , Muten Daisekichū) is a Landmark in . It is located at Yunnae's Rise on Elaice Highway.
Ecto Hollow (Japanese: , Ekuto no Chika Kūdō) is a Landmark in . It is located beneath the Apex Wing in Dannagh Desert. It becomes accessible during Invisible Bond.
The East-West Sector Passage (Japanese: , Tōzaikukan Renrakutsūro) is a Location in , located in the Origin Interior.

Effervescent Heart (Japanese: , Wakitatsu Kokoro) is an Ascension Quest in , dedicated to Isurd. Unlocking it requires having reached rank 10 for the Strategos class on one character, and having completed New Developments.
Droids are a family of enemies in . They are only found in Origin.

Electric Cricket Fossils are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Pentelas Region. They can also be produced from the Cascade Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. They are fossilized Electric Crickets from the Land of Morytha.
Dowdy Armor Kernels are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Aetia Region. They can also be produced from the Hillside Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Eclipse Marrins are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Marrin family, and can be found at level 55-56 near Raptor Perch in the Dannagh Desert. They drop Zapneedle Marrin Carapaces and Marrin Bones when defeated.

Eghi Rhoguls are Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are members of the Rhogul family, and can be found at level 64 at Urayan Tunnels in the Pentelas Region during Happiness; however, it also respawns after the quest and are the only boss in the game to do so. During and after Happiness, the four Eghi Rhoguls and one Rabdar Rhogul Elite Monster guard one Cozy Rhogul Egggems in their nest. Despite being in the Great Cotte Falls area near the entrance to Urayan Tunnels, the map considers its location as part of Urayan Tunnels area.

Dream Lemons are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region. They can also be purchased from the Colony 11 Caravan, or produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.
Dusticites are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region. They can also be produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.
Dynamic Coatings are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region. They can also be produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.
Drumstick Leeks are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be purchased from the Colony Mu Caravan, or produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Egg Seeds are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region, particularly in the Perimeter Woodland in Li Garte Prison Camp, or from the Fabricator at the Atoll Ferronis Hulk. It can also be purchased from Sunny & Cheerio's Caravan. 20 are required for Shock to the System.

Drague Everflames are items in . They can be dropped by Yolmun Dragues and Dreadwyrm Nizoont. They can be used to craft the following Gems: * Steady Striker VIII (x15) * Swelling Scourge IX (x20) * Analyze Weakness X (x30)
Dudan Quarduns are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Quardun family, and can be found at level 72-74 on Daedal Isle in Erythia Sea.
Dudan Quarmus are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Quarmu family, and can be found at level 72-74 on Daedal Isle in Erythia Sea.
Duel Merignas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Merigna family, and can be found at level 97-98 at the Emerald Font in Erythia Sea.
Earthwormwoods are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Aetia Region. They can also be produced from the Hillside Ferronis Hulk Fabricator after completing Reasons to Evolve.
Dully-Glowing Rocks are Collectible items in . They can be found in Origin.
Dumdum is a Nopon NPC in . Dumdum can be found at Atoll Ferronis Hulk.
Eilic, also known as No. 8, is an NPC in . He is a member of Colony 0 and can be found at Li Garte Prison Camp after In Search of a Home.
Drifter Scorpoxes are six Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Scorpox family, and are encountered at level 27 at Mine No. 2 in the Urayan Tunnels during Unwavering Resolve.
Draining Vacuum is a Battle Art in . It is one of the initial arts of the Soulhacker class.

Drone Arachnos are Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Arachno family, and are fought alongside the Midona Arachno at level 29 at Raptor Perch in the Dannagh Desert during Fla'ran's Request.
Dragon's Snarl is a Battle Art in . It is one of the arts of the Seraph class. The user spins their lance before thrusting it at an enemy while also suffering damage themselves.
Eightfold Divide (Japanese: ) is Taion's Ouroboros Talent Art in .
Dual Flash is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Noponic Champion class.
Earth Bind (Japanese: , Jijibari) is a Battle Art in . It is one of the arts of the Strategos class.
Dragon Unbound (Japanese: , Ryūko Funjin) is a Chain Art in . It is Teach's Chain Art during a Chain Attack.
Downdraft (Japanese: , Daundorafuto) is a Battle Art in . It is a variant of Driving Arrow that can only be used by Juniper. Juniper jumps backwards while firing an arrow down on enemies.

Dragon Gas is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It can be upgraded by fulfilling the condition of "Defeat the indicated monster(s): 10 Villainous Igna". It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Villainous Igna while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Dragon Decree is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Hardscale Gouran while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Dual Attack is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Seadragoon Melchior while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.
Driving Bullet (Japanese: , Doraibubaretto) is a Battle Art in . It is an Art of the Sharpshooter class, usable only by Mwamba.

Eclipse Soul () is a Status Effect in . It causes the affected character to attack their own allies, and prevents the player from controlling them. The debuff can only be inflicted by Moebius M when she uses the Art of the same name, during the encounter at the end of Chapter 5. If a character in an Ouroboros form is targeted, both members of the Interlink will be affected. Characters affected by the debuff are temporarily considered to be out of the player's party, resulting in the loss of the battle if they are the only characters left alive. During Moebius M's first phase, the affected character(s) cannot be targeted, and the debuff will not appear in the battle interface. In the second p
Dressy Suits are Casual Wear full body armor in and . They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries and are apart of the Suit armor range.
The Echoes of Gran Dell Citadel (Japanese: , Kuchita Guranderu Jōsai) is a Landmark in , located on the Aurora Shelf. It is the remains of Gran Dell.
Draiguls are a family of monsters in . They resemble the Dragons from and Dragues from .
Drigus Egels are Normal Enemies in . They are members of the Egel family, and can be found at level 34 in the Zalmor's Thawtunnels and the Declessa Cave Temple Ruins on the Aurora Shelf.
Egel Horns are items in . They can be dropped by Drigus or Shadow Egels in Aurora Shelf. The legendary variant can be dropped by Bioluminescent Bob at the Gotrock Oracle Ruins in Yesterdale.

Driver Vs is a track from , composed by ACE. It is track six of disc three on the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track six of disc eight on the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during battles against Driver enemies (except Unique Monsters). This track also appears as a DLC music track in , included alongside Pyra and Mythra's Fighter Pack. It is a track option on Gaur Plain, the Cloud Sea of Alrest, Final Destination, and the three variants of Battlefield.
Dreamworld Elysium is a Region in . It is an imaginary version of Elysium in Pyra and Mythra's dreams, created from their own memories.
The Dried Golden Shroom is a Key Item in . It can be obtained by examining the Treasure Chest located in the ruins at the back of Nerthis Necropolis after completing Ponspectors Till We Cry.
Earthology is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the north side of Division Drive, in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles between Neilnail and Cross.
Effect Charge is one of Liesel's two Signature Arts in . Cross can learn it by completing New Skell on the Block.
Du-ruga, the Sundering (Japanese: , Hakaishin Du-ruga) is a Tyrant in . It is a Xe-dom machine. It can be found at level 58 at Sierra Coripsus in Volitaris.

Duster Ponytails II are light head armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Dunban for the first time on the Battle Race course Twilight Speedway. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 3,800 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Dunban.

Duster Ponytails I are light head armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2000 for the first time with Dunban in the Score Attack course Caterpile Circuit. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 2,500 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Dunban.

Duster Tops I are light torso armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2200 for the first time with Dunban in the Score Attack course Jungle Rumble. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 4200 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Dunban.

Duster Tops II are light torso armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Dunban for the first time on the Battle Race course Midnight Forest. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 6300 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Dunban.

Duster Boots II are light feet armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Dunban for the first time on the Battle Race course Colony 9 Wild Ride. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 4500 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Dunban.

Duster Boots I are light feet armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2800 for the first time with Dunban in the Score Attack course Rural Road. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 3000 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Dunban.

Duster Leggings II are light legs armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Dunban for the first time on the Battle Race course Blizzard Rally. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 4900 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Dunban.

Duster Leggings I are light legs armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2600 for the first time with Dunban in the Score Attack course Valak Slalom. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 3300 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Dunban.

Duster Arms I are light arms armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2400 for the first time with Dunban in the Score Attack course Alcamoth Orbital. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 1600 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Dunban.

Duster Arms II are light arms armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Dunban for the first time on the Battle Race course Alcamoth at Dawn. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 2400 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Dunban.

Elaria is a DLC NPC in . She is an Ardainian who can be found by the Waypoint Market of Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya after Corvin is awakened. Approaching her with Corvin and Nia in the party results in a conversation which unlocks Corvin's level 2 "Light Mastery". Elaria is not known to appear at any other time.
Elasine is an NPC in . She is a Tantalese who can be found at Elmos Square in the Kingdom of Tantal.

Duvv is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found at Fonsa Myma Port in the Kingdom of Uraya during A Helping Hand, where he is in charge of one of the distribution centers for the Indoline refugee relief effort.

EZ Debuff Probes are types of Data Probes in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They boost successful debuff chances of nearby party members. Hugo gives one as a reward for completing the mission Data Probe Evolution. Another one is obtained by searching a helicopter near Balduino, the Wicked-Eyed in Noctilum's Sentinel's Nest. A third probe is located in vehicle wreckage near Bertrand, the Gorge Scourge in the East Ibra Ravine of Oblivia.
Ether Cylinders, often referred to simply as cylinders, are items which house various forms of energy, and are a component in creating Gems. There are two primary types of Cylinders in .

Enigma Lotuses (Japanese: , Aiyama) are collectables in . They can be found in Makna Forest. According to their description, they have a wonderful form when budding and they are valued as an ornamental flower. Six are required for Decoration Makeover.

Empress Beetles (Japanese: , Kougoutamamushi) are collectables in . They can be found in Frontier Village. According to their description, they emit a celestial light which attains intense beauty in their dying moments. Three are required for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In , they can be purchased from the Nopon Archsage in Time Attack for 10,100 Noponstones.
The Eryth Sea Collection is a portion of the Collectopaedia in .
Erik (Japanese: , Erikku) is a Homs in . He is a scientist who can be found near the Weapon Development Lab in Colony 9. He is dating Monica, but a vision shows that he is planning to dump her.

Emmy Leater (Japanese: , Emi Rīta) is a female Homs in . She is a captain in the Colony 9 Defence Force, with Miller being her sole subordinate. She can be found in the northern area of the Military District. Following Kantz's intention to retire from the Force, Emmy Leater aspires to become the new lieutenant colonel. Kantz, however, believes Raoul is more suited to the rank. Completing all Quests involving Emmy Leater unlocks Shulk's fifth skill branch, Bravery.

Ether Bunnias are enemies in . They are members of the Bunnia family, and can be found at level 26 north of the Glowing Obelisk in Satorl Marsh. They are the only enemies that drop Bunnia Ham, which is needed for A Delectable Delicacy.

Eryth Hilns are enemies in . They are members of the Hiln family, and can be found at level 33 in the Eryth Sea. They do not appear if it is raining. Six of them need to be defeated as part of A Friend in Need. They drop Hiln Coin Purses, three of which are needed for Eryth Sea's Collect Quest 1. They can also drop the Jagged Tails needed for Colony 6 Reconstruction.

Energy Aubergines (Japanese: , Sutami Nasu) are rare collectables in . They can be found in Mechonis Field and Colony 6. According to their description, it is a bitter green aubergine that builds stamina and it is recommended for men. Two are required for Finding the Unfindable. The Achievement "Auber the Top" will be awarded when a party member gives an Energy Aubergine as a gift to Reyn.
Eleqa (Japanese: , Erena) is a Machina in Xenoblade Chronicles. She can be found by the entrance to the Hidden Machina Village, but she goes back inside the village at 15:00.

En Argentis (Japanese: , En Shirubā, En Silver) is a High Entia NPC in . She is the sister of Zel Argentis and the daughter of Don Argentis. In Alcamoth, she can be found due south of the Fountain of Hope, standing by the flower bed around the edge of the large fountain. She can be found in Tephra Cave only during the quest Stopping the Elopement in which she is involved, and can propose a unique trade there. After the Mechonis Core event, if she has not been migrated to Colony 6, she can be found underneath the Ether Plant in Eryth Sea, hidden away on the cliff at the westernmost edge from about 20:00 to 03:00. An easier way to find her is to go to the escape pod, and set the time to 18:00.

This quest will expire after the decision to move to Colony 6. Emergency Treatment (Japanese: , Kusuri no Jikan) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Olga in the Refugee Camp on Bionis' Leg. As with all the quests in the Refugee Camp, it will expire when the residents migrate back to Colony 6. If Shulk is in the active party, he will comment.

Eryth Blue (Japanese: , Haieruto Burū) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found in Agniratha and in Colony 6. According to their description, Melia was sentimental when she named them and they are boards that are as blue as Eryth Sea.

Enchanting Grune (Japanese: , Miwaku no Guryūne) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Flamii family, and can be found at level 13 on the beach, east and below Tephra Cave Entrance in Colony 9 at 5:00. It can drop the Yolkless Flamii Egg needed for Material Quest 4.

Elior (Japanese: , Ein) is a High Entia in Xenoblade Chronicles. In Alcamoth, he can be found northeast of the Fountain of Eternity, at the transporter pad between the two long pools along the northernmost wall, from 06:00 to 18:00. After the Mechonis Core event, he moves to Refugee Camp on Bionis' Leg, where he can be found at the north edge of the lake, below the ledge, from 18:00 to 06:00.

Ether Def Down (Japanese: , Ēteru Taiseigen) is a Gem in that grants a chance of successful auto-attacks reducing the enemy's Ether Defence, thereby increasing the amount of damage that the enemy will take from ether attacks. __TOC__

The Escape Pod Bay (Japanese: , Dasshutsu Poddo Shitsu) is a location in . It is located on the ground floor of Tephra Cave. It is found just inside Mag Mell Ruins. A few Defence Force soldiers can be found here that give the party quests.

Empress Arms are heavy arms armour in . They can be dropped by numerous enemies in Colony 6, the Ether Mine, and Satorl Marsh. According to the in-game description, they were made by craftsmen in Satorl Marsh.
Empress Greaves are heavy feet armour in . They are made by craftsmen in Satorl Marsh.

Eryth Ansels (Japanese: , Eruto Anseru) are enemies in . They are members of the Ansel family, and can be found on Hovering Reefs 4, 5, 7, 9 of the Eryth Sea. They soar in the sky during daytime only. Three Eryth Ansels must be defeated for Monster Quest 1 - Part 2 in Alcamoth. They are the only source of Dense Ansel Meat, three lots of which are needed for Reversed Tastes in Frontier Village. They can also drop the Jagged Tails needed for Colony 6 Reconstruction.
Eryth Gear (Japanese: , Eruto Gia) is medium head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are commonly worn by High Entia troops.
Eryth Armour is medium torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is standard issue for High Entia troops. It is not dropped by any enemies, and must be bought or traded for.
Eryth Gauntlets are medium arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are standard issue for High Entia troops.
Engineer Belts are medium legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Eryth Leggings are medium legs armour in . They are commonly worn by High Entia troops.
Eryth Boots are medium feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are regular issue for High Entia troops. They can be dropped by Unine Hodes.
Ether Def Up (Japanese: , Ēteru Bōgyozō) is a Gem in that increases Ether Defence, which reduces the amount of damage that the character receives from ether-based attacks. __TOC__
Eleos Drones are Mechonis Drones in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained as a quest reward after completing various quests.

Ether Boosters are Mechonis boosters in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are made by fusing tissue from Homs with parts from Mechonis. They are part of Fiora's original armour, and cannot be obtained any other way.

Ether Arms are Mechonis arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are made by fusing the tissue of Homs with parts from Mechonis. They are part of Fiora's original armour, and cannot be obtained any other way.

Ether Frames are Mechonis frames in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are made by fusing Homs tissue with Mechon parts, possibly to support Fiora's damaged Homs body. They are part of Fiora's original armour, and cannot be obtained any other way.

Eliminate the Threat (Japanese: , Dōhō no tameni Dekiru koto) is a quest in . It can be received from Voltak inside the Junks on the Fallen Arm after completing Save the Machina! and reaching ☆1.5 in the Fallen Arm. If Melia is in the active party, she will comment.

Endless Rifles (Japanese: , Endoresuraifuru) are weapons in . They are ether rifles wielded by Sharla, and can be obtained from various high-level enemies. Endless Rifles are not otherwise obtainable.
Empire Pikes (Japanese: , Enpaiapaiku) are weapons in . They are gunlances wielded by Reyn, and can be obtained from numerous high-level enemies. Empire Pikes are also available as a quest reward.

The Ether Exhaust System (Japanese: , Ēteru Haishutsu Sōchi) is a location in . It is located on the Fallen Arm. It is a small circular building located at the south east from Black Wreckage (also north from Hidden Machina Village). It can be reached by swimming southeast from Digit 5 Beach to a smaller beach nearby. The Mechonis Key obtained after completing The Wilted Flower is required to go inside. The party is asked to investigate this place in Scheduled Inspection, and this is the home of Evil Bathin.
Endymion (Japanese: , Endimion) is one of Dunban's swords in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Eternity Knives (Japanese: , Etanitinaifu) are weapons in . They are twin blades wielded by Fiora.

The Empress Staff (Japanese: , Jotei no Shakujō) is a weapon in . It is a staff wielded by Melia and obtainable as a reward after completing Melancholy Tyrea. It was the staff that was once used by Yumea prior to becoming a Telethia.

The Empress Mask (Japanese: , Kōjo no Kamen) is light head armour in . It is a ceremonial mask worn by the High Entia queen. It is temporarily worn by Melia at one point in the story, and cannot be removed, sold during the time she wears it, or kept in inventory after this event. The high weight is an oddity for light armour. It is probably classified as light armour because that is the only type Melia can wear initially, and the weight may be intended to simulate the effects of reduced vision by reducing her agility.

The Entry Bridge (Japanese: , Deiri no Hashi) is a landmark in . It is located on the first basement floor of Frontier Village. The village for Nopon is beyond the bridge, as it is the entrance to Frontier Village. In , a Time Attack portal can be found here.

Eryth Rhanas are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Rhana family, and can be found at level 87 on Anu Shore and at the unnamed shore north of the Ether Plant, both at Eryth Sea. They can drop the Thick Rhana Hides needed for A Token of Friendship.
This is a list of name and term pronunciations used in those dubs, in broad International Phonetic Alphabet transcription.

Elegant Marin (Japanese: , Yūbina Mārin) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Krabble family, and can be found at level 29 in the Ether Mine near Glowmoss Lake. Elegant Marin is a target for the quest What is Courage?!. Completing the quest requires defeating either Elegant Marin or the Hungry Volff. If Elegant Marin is defeated first, it is not possible to fight the Hungry Volff during the same playthrough.

Erratic Goliante (Japanese: , Ruten no Goriante) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Gogol family, and can be found at level 97 in front of the entrance to the Trader's Stopover at the Heavenly Window landmark in Tephra Cave after the events of Mechonis Core (Chapter 17). It can drop the Gogol Horns needed for A Token of Friendship and Colony 6 Reconstruction. It has massive topple Spike Damage (2280 damage per hit), therefore it is not a good idea to topple it unless the party has strong Spike Defence from gems or skill links.

Element Chunks are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be obtained from intermediate-level Nebulae. Element Chunks are otherwise unavailable. According to their description, they shine in seven colours and it is said they combine every element.

The Emergency Warehouse (Japanese: , Taishō Hijō-yō Sōko) is a location in . It is located on the first floor of Tephra Cave, hidden by a waterfall in the south part of Vilia Lake. After the events at Mechonis Core, Dulland will offer the party the quest Securing Provisions, during which they will obtain the key for the locked door to this room. There are no enemies here.

Ether Down (Japanese: , Ēteru Genshō) is a Gem in that grants a chance that successful auto-attacks will lower the target's Ether, thereby reducing the damage dealt by its ether-based attacks. __TOC__
Elucas (Japanese: , Erūka) a family of enemies in the . They are are pink, worm-like creatures resembling Caterpiles, although they tend to be larger. All Elucas look identical.

Elemental Discharge (Japanese: , Eremento Hassha) is Melia's Talent Art in and . It discharges the most recently summoned elemental, hitting once with an Ether attack. Unlike other characters' talent arts, Elemental Discharge can be used anytime, regardless of the state of her Talent Gauge, so long as she has at least one summoned elemental. Using this talent art fills her Talent Gauge by 10%, or 15% if used within 5 seconds of discharging a different elemental.
The Enlarging Seaweed is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is made during Getting Bigger and is required in the accompanying quest, Who is Bigger?.

Eternal Palsadia (Japanese: , Eigō no Paresu Atena, lit. Pallas Athena of the Eons) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Queen family. It can be found on the top of the Exile Fortress after completing the quest The Giants' Treasure during later visits.
This page is a list of all the Unique Monsters in the Eryth Sea.

Envy Sardis (Japanese: , Envi Sādi) are enemies in . They are members of the Sardi family, and can be found at level 77 near the shorelines in Raguel Lake on the Bionis' Leg. An Envy Sardi also appears in the Tranquil Grotto. It can drop the Ancient Sardi Meat needed for Colony 6 Reconstruction.

Envy Gogols (Japanese: , Envi Gogōru) are enemies in . They are members of the Gogol family, and can be found at level 80 on Bionis' Leg inside Pandora Pods in the cavern in Windy Cave near the Mysterious Barnaby and on the cliffs north of Kamos Guidepost. They can drop the Gogol Horns needed for A Token of Friendship and Colony 6 Reconstruction.
Engage (Japanese: , Engēji) is one of Reyn's arts in . It activates an aura that may inflict Lock-On to enemies and increases Mad Taunt's aggro by 25%. In , Nene uses this art.

Ether Drain (Japanese: , Ēteru Dorein) is one Fiora's Ether status arts in . It reduces the target's Ether by 20%. It also raises Fiora's Ether by 20%, plus 5% for each additional enemy after the first.

The Enalda Control Base (Japanese: , Enaruda Kanri Kichi) is a landmark in . It is the third of the four Mechon facilities in Sword Valley, beyond Ged Fortress and Dolgan Outpost, just before Galahad Fortress. It is a two story building located on the side of the Ether Storage Area location. On the first floor, it houses the control panel for the 3rd Gate and its Unique Monster, the Tranquil Morax. It has a balcony-like platform that wraps around the second floor, including a space similar to an alley behind the base, where four large Mechon attempt to pin the party in when they arrive. Besides Galahad Fortress, it is the largest and most hazardous of the Sword Valley facilities, and include

This quest will expire after the events at the Mechonis Core. Eliminate the Backup! (Japanese: , Taikibutai wo Tatake) is a Timed Surprise Quest in . It can be received while arriving at the Storage Depot in Central Factory.

Energy Devices (Japanese: , Enerugī Sōchi) are three stationary story exclusive and quest exclusive Mechon in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found at level 70 at the Mechonis Core during the boss battle event against Yaldabaoth. They are involved in the Story Quest Save Bionis. They do not carry or drop any treasure.

Emergency Rations are Key Items in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are the object of Securing Provisions. They can be found in the Emergency Warehouse, which is located behind a waterfall in the south of Vilia Lake in Tephra Cave. They are also given by Elior when accepting Supplies for Satorl.

Electric Upa Tears are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are dropped by Upas on the Fallen Arm and can be traded for on the Fallen Arm. According to their description, they are electrically-charged tears only shed by Upas when they are laying eggs. Five of them are needed for the quest The Wilted Flower.

The Electrical Fuse is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. Along with the Ether Explosive and the Timer, it is one of three items required to complete Materials for a Bomb. It can be obtained by defeating the M88 Watchtower near the Main Factory Gate in the Central Factory.

The Ether Explosive is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. Along with the Electrical Fuse and the Timer, it is one of three items required to complete Materials for a Bomb. It can be obtained by defeating M97 Commander in the Large Mechon Store in the Central Factory.
Ether Crystals, or simply crystals, are items in . Ether Crystals are Ether in solid form. Through the process of Gem Crafting, Ether Crystals can be processed into Gems.

The Ether Blast Furnace (Japanese: , Ēteru Yōkōro) is a landmark in . It is a circular platform above a lake of Ether located on the second basement floor of Galahad Fortress, directly west of the Ether Input Stream and east of the Preparation Bay. The Glorious Jurom, a Unique Monster, guards the area along with a few smaller Mechon units. Four Ether Gears can also be found here.
Element Essences are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various Nebulae. Element Essences are not otherwise available.
Element Fragments are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from various low-level Nebula. Element Fragments are not otherwise available.

Elma (Japanese: , Eruma; English dub: ) is one of the eight main playable characters of . She is the central character of the main story. She is a BLADE colonel and the team leader of the Reclaimers Division. In the prologue, she is tasked with retrieving the Lifepods that were ejected from the United States Ark Ship, the White Whale. She is the first party member to join Cross after waking them from their Lifepod. Prior to Earth's destruction, she served as the colonel of the Coalition Heavy Armor Training Unit, or the "Skelleton Crew". She was a partner to the hero who repelled the attack on the White Whale as it crashed on Mira.
Enduring Friendship (Japanese: , Yuruginai Kizuna, Unshakeable Bonds) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Tephra Cave Entrance in Colony 9, between Shulk and Reyn at green affinity.
Eternal Scars (Japanese: , Kienai Kizu wo Kakaete) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Black Wreckage on the Fallen Arm, between Dunban and Melia at pink affinity.

Enforcer (known as Forcer in the Japanese version) is a Class featured in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is one of three classes that can be changed from Drifter. The Enforcer is specialised in Support and Ranged Arts. This class provides bonuses to ranged attack and potential. The basic equipped Weapons are Knives and Rayguns. Once the Class Rank is complete, it gives access to the specialised to Psycorruptor or Blast Fencer. The basic Arts of the Enforcer are Beam Barrage and Repair.
Electric Surge is a Dual Swords Art in . It deals greater damage as the HP decrease.
The Empress' Ornament is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is dropped by the Daughter Empress during It Definitely Exist!, and must be delivered to Pachipa.
Ether Defence is a stat which reduces the amount of damage received from ether attacks.

Enemies Closing In (敵の猛追, Hectic Pursuit of the Enemy) is a Field Track in and , composed and arranged by ACE+. It is track 2 of disc 4 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is heard in battle either when a party member is incapacitated or when party tension is dangerously low. Reviving fallen party members and restoring tension will negate this theme and resume the previous battle theme. Until then, however, this theme is meant to alert the player to the danger the party is in.

Epilogue (エピローグ) is an Event Track in Xenoblade Chronicles, composed and arranged by Yoko Shimomura, with additional arrangement by Tsutomu Narita. It is track 20 of disc 2 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is heard only once, during the Staff Credits after completing the game.

]] The Enemy Index, or Enemy Guide in Japanese versions, is the bestiary in . This guide allows to collect all the data about the Enemies fought by the party throughout the game, organized by category and subcategory. It also features biology notes for each species. There are no rewards or achievements for completing the Enemy Index. An entry is added to the Enemy Index when the party enters combat with the opponent, even if the party flees the battle. Defeating a particular enemy 1 – 3 times will update the entry with more details, including its HP and other stats, resistances, base EXP awarded for defeating it, and special conditions for appearances like time or weather. Essence Exchange is one of Yelv's two Signature Arts in . Cross can learn it by completing Arms and the Man.

Eleonora (Japanese: , Ereonōra; English dub: ) is an NPC and BLADE member in . She can be found in front of the Mission Board at BLADE Concourse in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. Each time Cross's BLADE Level increases, they can speak to Eleonora to upgrade one of their Field-Skills. This feature is absent in the .

The Elephant's Trunk (Japanese: , Zōnohana) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, north of Tripod Rock. This land bridge connects the lower and upper halves of the region. FN Site 220 can be found here.

Eternal Millesaurs (Japanese: , Etānaru Mirezauro) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Millesaur family, and can be found between levels 41-50 at Sayram Lake in Primordia. They can drop the Obsidian Fragments needed for The Nopon Heir.

Eliane, the Unmoved (Japanese: , Shinchin no Eriānu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Mortifole, and can be found hidden at level 29 on the riverbank below a ledge, southeast of FN Site 312 in Oblivia. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Eliane, the Unmoved.

The Ensanguined Font (Japanese: , Hikōsen) is an Unexplored Territory in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, in a cave that runs between the Waterway Tangle and Garden Spring. It is large enough to permit Skell's entry and must be visited during Frontier Spirit. At night it is the sole location of the Spore Filiavent. As with all Unexplored Territories, its discovery merits an achievement ("Colors of the Ensanguined Font").

Ether Defence Down (also called Ether Def Down) is a Debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles. It reduces the target's Ether Defence, thereby increasing the damage received from ether attacks. When inflicted on a party member, the character's ether defence is reduced by a percentage. For example, if the character's ether defence is 200, an Ether Def Down 25% debuff would reduce it to 150, causing him to take an extra 50 points of damage from ether attacks. When inflicted on an enemy, the debuff's percentage is subtracted from the enemy's ether defence percentage, possibly reducing it below zero. For example, if one enemy's ether defence is 80% and another's is 25%, inflicting Ether Def Down 50% would

Element Burst is one of Melia's auras in and . It is triggered automatically when her Talent Gauge is full. It doubles the amount of damage dealt by Elemental Discharge, and also enables the use of her Burst End and Mind Blast arts.

Endeavorer Adseculas (Japanese: , Benchā Apisu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Adsecula family, and can be found at level 42-50 in Sylvalum, at West Ciel Sandsea or at Behemoth's Shadows.
Ether Blast is one of many Ranged Arts in . It inflicts Ether damage to the enemies.
Energy Source is a Support Art in . It transfers 1000 TP to target and boosts their potential.

Emotion Commotion (Japanese: , Kanjō wo Kaiseki suru, Analysing Emotions) is a Normal Mission in . It can be received from Chiopitus on Barista Court in the Commercial District. Once the mission is available after completing Chapter 7, the Rowdy Potamus and a level 1 mechanical Treasure Box (#636) corresponding to Christopher's damaged Skell by the potamus emitting black smoke, appear at Sickle Rock Rise. Although only defeating the potamus is a mission objective, the Treasure Box is linked to this mission and will disappear upon completing the third objective. This Treasure Box is thus missable, it contains a Bargain Tank Top (White).
Emerian Battlegrounds (Japanese: , Emeria Kosenjō-ato) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros, north of the Titan's Table.

Enhanced Barrager Zigs (Japanese: , Enhansubaretto Jigu) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Zig machines and can be found at level 31-40 at South Silent Sandsea and on ledges throughout Sylvalum.
Eliza (Japanese: , Iraiza) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the Cathedral in the Residential District of New Los Angeles.

The Ensconced Citadel (Japanese: , Ōiwa Yōsai) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Ganglion base located in Noctilum, northeast of the FN Site 211. A path inhabited by Pike Insidias leads southeast to the Skygazer's Atrium and Weeping Whitewood. There are several archeological Treasure Boxes here.

Eradicator Eyepieces (Japanese: , Jenosaidoai) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia, on top of the rock formation in the middle of Sea Whisper Valley or in Jair Fortress. Five Eradicator Eyepieces are required for the Normal Mission Good Neighbors.

Eternal Mosses (Japanese: , Ikuokuman no Kokekuzu) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum, in particular on the water around FN Site 209 and FN Site 216. Ten are needed for Sumptuous Sleeping.

Emerald Grapes (Japanese: , Emerarudo Gurēpu) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum, in particular at the Behemoth's Shadows entrance near FN Site 420, or inside caves such as Behemoth's Shadow and Den of the Dead. Seven of them are required for The Poshest Produce.
Elemental Batteries (Japanese: , Eremento Batterī) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros.
Energy Tubes are common materials in . They can be obtained from Puges in Primordia. Two are needed during The Repair Job. fr:Tube d'alimentation

The Enhancer Satellis (Japanese: , Enhansu Sateresu) is a Main Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is fought at level 48 at Lifehold Core's Interior during Chapter 12. It assists the Vita during the second battle round. The Enhancer Satellis orbits the Vita when summoned, granting additional affects to some of the Vita's attacks and granting it Evasion Up VI and Gravity Resistance Up VI buffs. This boss and the other Satellises are not registered in the Enemy Index, only the Vita and the Sentinel Satellis will be registered.

Ernest, the Contemplative (Japanese: , Sakukage no Erunesuto) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Progen family. It can be found at level 36 west of King's Falls in Oblivia. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Ernest, the Contemplative.

Elena, the Infernal (, Meifu no Erena) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Scirpo family. It can be found at level 79 at Weeping Whitewood in Noctilum during dense fog weather. It spawns on top of the hill before walking southwestward along the path. It is far larger than normal scirpos; its acid sac alone being taller than a Skell. Killing it is required for segment recon.

The Enhanced Attack Seidr (Japanese: , Kōgeki Kyōka-gata Basugia) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Ganglion Seidr machine. It can be found at level 68 at Kitsune Stronghold in Cauldros, boxed in by a collection of buildings.
The Enhanced Support Zig (Japanese: , Shien Kyōka-gata Jigu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Zig Ganglion machine. It can be found at level 37 at the Dragonbone Promontory in Cauldros.

The Enhanced Attack Range Zig (Japanese: , Kōgeki Han'i Kyōka-gen Jigu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Zig Ganglion machine. It can be found at level 37 at the Ganglion Weapons Hangar in Cauldros.

The Enhanced Search Zig (Japanese: , Sakuteki Kyōka-gata Jigu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Zig Ganglion machine. It can be found at level 48 at Wildcat Fortress in Cauldros, atop the southern tower at the gate to the fast travel point. It must be defeated for Squad Mission No.8.

Erbium Petramands (Japanese: , Erubiumu Aranea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Petramand family, and can be found at level 53-55 in Capital Wreckage and at level 51-54 on the slopes of Mount M'gando in Cauldros. Five must be defeated for Arms Testers Wanted.

Electro Duoguills (Japanese: , Erekutoro Guira) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Duoguill family and can be found at level 50 in Floating Reef in Oblivia, in the enclosed area with the heart-shaped pool.
Electric Scintimures (Japanese: , Erekuto Torizumo) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Scintimure family, and can be found at level 11-20 in Noctilum's Sato Headwater.
Enduron Leads are common Precious Resources in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are components of many Rank X augments. Three lumps of Enduron Lead are needed for The Matchmaker.

Elemental Cluster are materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Oc-servs' spines in Sylvalum, in particular the Tellurium Oc-servs appearing near South Hardheart Canyon, or the Niobium Oc-servs. They can also be redeemed using 54 Reward Tickets. Two are needed for Emotion Commotion.
Enneana Spicar (Japanese: , EEn'neana Supikaru) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Tree Clan Prone and can be found at the Starboard of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.
Engine Wreckage is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is found near Lake Ciel in Noctilum and must be gathered during Waste Not, Want Not.

Elite Supercivilization Attire is a casual full body armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be seen as an upgraded version of Celica's Bodywear, to the point of having the exact same appearance. It can only be obtained through crafting and can only be equipped by female characters, and has the same appearance on all of them.
Ether Boost is a Skill in . It is unlocked as a Blast Fencer at rank 1.
Enhanced Gunner Zigs (Japanese: , Enhansukyanon Jigu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Zig machines, and can be found at level 41-50 on T'phnom Shelf north of FN Site 511 in Cauldros.

Enhanced Launcher Zigs (Japanese: , Enhansuranchā Jigu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Zig machines, and can be found at at level 51 southwest of FN Site 415 and at level 60 atop Arc Rock in Sylvalum.

The Empress Insidia (Japanese: , Enpuresu Parako) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Insidia family, and is fought at level 45 at Weeping Whitewood in Noctilum during Climbing the Ladder.
Entrepreneurial Spirit (Japanese: , Inochi no Kane, Life Money) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Tobias in the Central Industrial District of New Los Angeles.
Elma's Task A is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is received automatically during Gwin's Affinity Mission Boot Camp.
Elma's Task B is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is received automatically during Gwin's Affinity Mission Boot Camp.
Elma's Task C is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is received automatically during Gwin's Affinity Mission Boot Camp.
Emerald Horns are common materials in . They can be obtained from pink Xiphias in Sylvalum's Behemoth's Shadows. They are components in Appendage Crusher augments.

|-|Male= |-|Female= Erio (Japanese: , Erio) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Erio is the Human appearance of HT665: Erio, and has a separate entry in the Affinity Chart. Erio's appearance and gender are determined when Definian Downfall is completed, being female if Cross is male, and male if Cross is female. They can be found by the round garden southeast of the Residential District's Cathedral, and later near the Barista Court in the Commercial District.
Elusive Orewood is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Curators and the primary destination is Primordia.
Emergency Stores is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a general store owner to obtain Katoan Leaves in Noctilum.
Engrossed in Grosium is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Meredith & Co. and the primary destination is Primordia.

Escort Requested is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Alice and the primary destination is the Residential District. This mission leads into The Line of Fire, though accepting it is not a prerequisite.
Estate Sale is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located anytime at a balcony in Ishmael Hills in the Residential District of New Los Angeles between Murderess and Cross.
Emerald Whiskey are rare materials in . They can be obtained from blue Arenatects. They are components in Overdrive Blue Bonus augments.

Electric Tersqual Tears are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from green Tersquals, or for 138 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Melee: Shock, M-Auto.SHOCK, and TimeEx.SHOCK augments.

Electrified Xeno Blood is a common material in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be obtained from Goetia. It is also given out as rewards for completing the Time Attack Mission Xeno from the Abyss. It is a component of Melee: Shock and M-Auto.SHOCK augments.
Elemental Fragments are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Oc-servs.
Eternal Arenatect Moss is a rare material in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Arenatects.
